title: Localized inverse-image constant models under field scalar extension
statement: Let Y,X be schemes and g:X→Y any morphism [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]. Let k→k' be a unital field map, R=k_Y and S=k'_Y the constant ring sheaves [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf], and T= - tensor_R S the specified ordinary scalar-extension functor [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-tower]. For an R-module sheaf F, a site object V of X_proet, and a k-module M, suppose the restrictions to V of g^{-1}F and g^{-1} of the constant module sheaf M are isomorphic as modules over g^{-1}R. Then the restrictions to V of g^{-1}T(F) and g^{-1} of the constant k'-module sheaf k' tensor_k M are isomorphic as modules over g^{-1}S. The conclusion uses the actual inverse-image coefficient sheaves and the target scalar action on the k' factor. No finiteness, cover or immersion condition is imposed.

proof.text: Construct scalar extension on the original site and its slices as the actual sectionwise tensor presheaf followed by module sheafification. Compose the sectionwise ModuleCat tensor/restriction Hom equivalences with the module-sheafification adjunction. Naturality on pure tensors proves that this gives the tensor/restriction adjunction in the independent site object and Hom universes. Uniqueness of left adjoints identifies this concrete tensor functor on a scheme with pbcExtend.

For a scheme map g and a coefficient map a:R→S, naturality of the ring inverse-image adjunction unit identifies direct image over g^{-1}S followed by scalar restriction along a with scalar restriction along g^{-1}a followed by direct image over g^{-1}R. The comparison is the identity on sections, linearity being exactly that unit equation. Conjugate it by the inverse-image and scalar-extension adjunctions. This gives pbcExtend(a) followed by inverse image over S isomorphic to inverse image over R followed by pbcExtend(g^{-1}a).

For a site object V, slice restriction is left adjoint to module direct image along Over.star V, by Mathlib SheafOfModules.overPushforwardOverAdj. Scalar restriction commutes with that direct image: both scalar actions are equal by naturality of a along the product projection V×U→U. Conjugate this comparison by the tensor and slice adjunctions, obtaining extension of scalars commuting with slice restriction. Apply that slice tensor functor to the given local isomorphism.

The constant module presheaf functor is left adjoint to evaluation at the terminal site object: a morphism is determined there and all other components are its composites with restriction. Compose with module sheafification to obtain the constant-module / constant-scalar-section adjunction. Naturality of the constant-ring sheafification unit makes scalar restriction commute with constant-scalar sections. Uniqueness of left adjoints identifies scalar extension of the constant module M with the constant module k′ tensor_k M. Combine this global comparison, the inverse-image and slice comparisons, the image of the supplied local isomorphism, and the inverse comparison for the constant module. The result is over the actual inverse-image target ring, since every comparison is in that module category. No finiteness, flatness, immersion, cover or inhabited-object hypothesis enters; the zero and empty cases follow from the same adjunctions.

proof_origin.place: V7: Tags 03EL, 0GMW and 093V. The implemented argument uses the tensor/restriction, inverse-image/direct-image, slice/direct-image and constant-module/sections adjunctions. Mathlib overPushforwardOverAdj supplies the slice adjunction; the other comparisons are constructed explicitly.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteFieldScalarExtension_localModel
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) {k k' : Type u} [Field k] [Field k'] (f : k →+* k') :
    ∀ (X : Scheme.{u}) (g : X ⟶ Y)
      (F : pbcModules Y (adicLisseConstantRing Y (ULift.{u + 1} k)))
      (V : X.ProEt) (M : ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} k)),
      Nonempty ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor _ V).obj
        ((proEtaleModuleInverseImage g
          (adicLisseConstantRing Y (ULift.{u + 1} k))).obj F) ≅
        (SheafOfModules.overFunctor _ V).obj
          ((proEtaleModuleInverseImage g
            (adicLisseConstantRing Y (ULift.{u + 1} k))).obj
            ((adicLisseConstantModules Y (ULift.{u + 1} k)).obj M))) →
      Nonempty ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor _ V).obj
        ((proEtaleModuleInverseImage g
          (adicLisseConstantRing Y (ULift.{u + 1} k'))).obj
          ((pbcExtend ((constantSheaf (ProEt.topology Y) CommRingCat.{u + 1}).map
            (CommRingCat.ofHom (RingHom.ulift.{u + 1, u + 1} f)))).obj F)) ≅
        (SheafOfModules.overFunctor _ V).obj
          ((proEtaleModuleInverseImage g
            (adicLisseConstantRing Y (ULift.{u + 1} k'))).obj
            ((adicLisseConstantModules Y (ULift.{u + 1} k')).obj
              ((ModuleCat.extendScalars (RingHom.ulift.{u + 1, u + 1} f)).obj M))))
